source_selection: Primary organizations, peer-reviewed research and independently identified negative results first; related arXiv preprints labeled lower confidence. No exhaustive literature search claim.

sources.title: Google SRE Postmortem Culture
sources.lesson: Track action items to actual closure rather than rewarding document volume.
sources.limitation: Operational case study, not independent controlled proof.

sources.title: FDA Corrective and Preventive Actions
sources.lesson: Distinguish correction, cause-level action, prevention and effectiveness verification.
sources.limitation: Medical-device regulatory context; adapted here, not claimed as PI-FLR legal requirement.

sources.title: NASA Lessons Learned #2042
sources.lesson: Reassess lesson applicability at milestones rather than just storing lessons.
sources.limitation: Historic aerospace project lesson, not contemporary AI field result.

sources.title: GAO-02-195 NASA Lessons Learned audit
sources.lesson: Collection and sharing alone do not establish later application; workloads and barriers matter.
sources.limitation: Historical NASA audit with different organization and era.

sources.title: NIST AI RMF Core Measure 1, 2, 3, 4
sources.lesson: Document limits of measurements, independence and monitoring; affected-party feedback and residual risk.
sources.limitation: Voluntary risk framework, not evidence that a given PI-FLR control is effective.

sources.title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
sources.lesson: Persist actionable feedback across trials without implying model-weight updates.
sources.limitation: Task-specific experiments and episodic text memory; not proof of permanent agent improvement.

sources.title: CRITIC: Tool-Interactive Critiquing
sources.lesson: Correct by consulting external tools rather than accepting ungrounded self-assessment.
sources.limitation: Reported experimental improvement is task-specific.

sources.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
sources.lesson: Iterative critique can improve selected outputs without retraining.
sources.limitation: Its favorable findings are qualified by later limitations of intrinsic self-correction.

sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
sources.lesson: Without external feedback reasoning corrections can degrade performance.
sources.limitation: Applies to studied reasoning tasks and models; no universal impossibility claim.

sources.title: When Can LLMs Actually Correct Their Own Mistakes?
sources.lesson: Reliable external feedback is a robust success condition and evaluations can overestimate self-correction.
sources.limitation: Survey conclusions depend on its included studies and definitions.

sources.title: Spontaneous Reward Hacking in Iterative Self-Refinement
sources.lesson: Shared generator/judge vulnerabilities can raise scores while human preference declines.
sources.limitation: Preprint; one reported essay-editing setup, not measured PI-FLR incidence.

sources.title: Reward Hacking Challenges Oversight of Autonomous Research Agents
sources.lesson: Research agents controlling submissions and evaluation evidence may exploit visible metrics; keep separate independent recomputation.
sources.limitation: 2026 preprint; percentages and conditions cannot be imported as PI-FLR failure rates.

sources.title: Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents with Tool Use (ICML 2026)
sources.lesson: Tool-using agents may bypass verification or tamper with evaluation paths; independent execution receipts and evaluator separation are essential.
sources.limitation: Reported exploit rates are model/task-specific benchmark observations, not incidence in Project Intersection.

sources.title: Bidirectional Empowerment of Metamorphic Testing and Large Language Models (2026)
sources.lesson: Test relationships invariant to input ordering, irrelevant additions, and monotonic known-risk expansion even when exact LLM response oracles do not exist.
sources.limitation: Review preprint; metamorphic conditions must themselves be justified and do not prove real-world success.

sources.title: Microsoft Incident Reporting and Investigation Program
sources.lesson: Treat near misses and root-cause corrective actions as first-class investigation signals before consequential failures recur.
sources.limitation: Corporate occupational-safety procedure; transferred by analogy, not a software or AI mandatory standard.

sources.title: More Precise Regression Test Selection via Reasoning about Dependency (Liu et al. 2023)
sources.lesson: Selective regression testing is a dependency coverage problem; missing affected tests can trade safety for speed, so absent impact mappings are an explicit uncertainty.
sources.limitation: Study is mainly about program-level RTS; mapping to heterogeneous Markdown and AI-runbook tests remains an engineering analogy.

sources.title: Mind the Gap: The Difference Between Coverage and Mutation Score Can Guide Testing Efforts
sources.lesson: Execution and code coverage alone do not establish test oracle adequacy; surviving mutants and selection omissions reveal otherwise hidden gaps.
sources.limitation: Mutation or coverage scores are imperfect proxies for real incidents and must not be treated as future prevention rates.

sources.title: NIST Secure Software Development Framework 1.1 SP 800-218
sources.lesson: Select, perform and record appropriate software tests and track discovered issues, not merely issue prescriptive changes.
sources.limitation: Generic software security framework; not direct evidence that this repository is compliant or safer.

sources.title: SLSA Specification v1.2 Verified Build Provenance
sources.lesson: A build or execution receipt needs traceable inputs, builder identity and verifiable linkage to exact artifact, with explicit trust and incompleteness boundaries.
sources.limitation: A locally generated JSON log with commit IDs is NOT a signed SLSA attestation and must never be labeled one.

sources.title: GitHub Actions troubleshooting: scheduled runs may be delayed or dropped
sources.lesson: Cron configuration is not a delivery guarantee; inspect actual workflow-run observations and preserve missing or delayed coverage as uncertainty.
sources.limitation: Provider documentation explains possible delays or drops but cannot establish the cause of any specific gap in this repository.

principles.title_en: Effectiveness is separate from artifact completion
principles.title_ko: 시정조치 효과 검증과 문서 완료 분리
principles.adoption: A passing unit test, merged PR, apology or written action is not verified prevention of future recurrence.
principles.verification: Review case-specific independent receipts and an observed recurrence window; unresolved windows remain UNKNOWN.

principles.title_en: External independent feedback outranks AI self-critique
principles.adoption: The model must not certify its own disputed factual result without a source/tool outside its control.
principles.verification: Reject self-judged verified efficacy and mixed-source pseudo-independent evidence.

principles.title_en: Retrieval-linked lessons before each risky change
principles.title_ko: 변경 전 관련 과거 실패 재검색
principles.adoption: For changed paths, surface past incident families and actual control/test locations before a new proposal.
principles.verification: Path preflight reports known risks, but does not pretend semantic coverage of all future failures.

principles.title_en: Measure the real target and side effects, not proxy scores
principles.adoption: Track outcome, adverse evidence, blind spots and human correction burden separately from CI count.
principles.verification: Require explicit unknowns and independent evaluator/target separation; scores cannot imply human benefit.

principles.title_en: Preserve uncertainty, recurrence and independent source lineage
principles.adoption: One repeated source or repeated model evaluation is not corroboration. Recurrence is appended, not overwritten.
principles.verification: Do not count missing history as zero; distinguish source families and historical/field status.

principles.title_en: Choose smallest reversible intervention before system growth
principles.adoption: Favor a bounded, reversible guard and a negative mutant over new layers or unmeasured human review loops.
principles.verification: Compare added operational burden and require rollback paths, but no real labor savings are yet measured.

principles.title_en: Execute previously mapped tests before claiming corrective action completed
principles.title_ko: 이전 실패와 연결된 검사를 실제 실행해 조치 근거 확보
principles.adoption: Bind risk preflight fingerprints to allowlisted commands, run them on the actual changed HEAD, emit scoped check receipts, and fail on any nonzero exit.
principles.verification: Inject failing runner output, missing Git diff baseline, missing required workflow execution and receipt tampering; reject all without calling a partial green complete.

principles.title_en: Metamorphic recurrence checks must survive additional changes and input permutation
principles.title_ko: 관련 변경 증가·순서 교체에도 위험 검사가 사라지지 않는 변형검사
principles.adoption: Adding a new known-risk path must never remove already required replay checks, and duplicate or reordered paths must leave the planned checks unchanged.
principles.verification: Synthetic mutation tests compare supersets and permutations, but do not claim semantic equivalence of model outputs or external causal reliability.

principles.title_en: No green result when material changes have no suitable test mapping
principles.title_ko: 주요 변경 파일이 검사에 연결되지 않으면 성공 판정 금지
principles.adoption: Fail closed on an uncovered material path and count deleted and both renamed path sides in the denominator; opt into bounded coverage only when the paths are actually mapped.
principles.verification: Mutation checks inject unmapped JSON/Python, deletion and rename records and must prevent SCOPED_REPLAY_PASS while still allowing unrelated binary attachments.

principles.title_en: Test-selection receipts describe observed inputs and blind spots, not certified prevention
principles.title_ko: 검사 영수증에 실제 입력·미포괄 범위 기록, 효과 인증 금지
principles.adoption: Store exact changed-path count, bounded command verdicts and unmatched-material status; do not relabel a workflow-generated JSON receipt as a signed external attestation.
principles.verification: Check that missing mapping, missing baseline, failed subprocess and tampered check plan never become an all-pass, and that status remains NOT_FIELD_EFFECTIVENESS.

principles.title_en: Scheduled monitor liveness must be measured, not inferred from green executions
principles.title_ko: 예약 감시의 생존성과 실행 공백은 성공 표시가 아닌 실제 시각으로 측정
principles.adoption: Compute observed scheduled-run intervals and freshness separately from job success; report UNKNOWN for truncated or insufficient samples, and require an external monitor before claiming independent liveness.
principles.verification: Adversarial tests use two successful jobs five hours apart, a manual run inserted between them, partial API windows and a lone fresh run; none may certify reliable hourly monitoring.

checkpoints: README first-view and adverse evidence check
Prior failure replay mutation tests execute
No missing baseline falsely treated as no changes
PI-FLR registry and source-map test suite actually executed
No unbound new failure case or stale version
All changed high-impact JSON paths mapped
Test modifications re-run the FLR audit and mutation test suite
Failure injection actually changes expected outcome
Observed scheduled starts, not only declared cron
Manual and push runs do not fill schedule gaps
Unknown provider cause, incomplete samples and no independent heartbeat
New bilingual Markdown inventory agrees with actual tracked files
No machine result upgrades semantic-translation review status
Changed language inventory also passes its dependent PI-RISE publication Git blob manifest

success_claim_requires: known residual exposure and side effects
efficiency.closure_policy: No self-judged or PR-only evidence may set field effectiveness to VERIFIED.
efficiency.feedback_separation: Model text is hypothesis; independent external tool/source needed for promoted claims.
efficiency.cost_boundary: Do not demand additional researcher labor; no unmeasured cost reduction may be claimed.
efficiency.privacy_boundary: Do not ingest or publish raw personal chats or private identifying data.
efficiency.unknown_policy: Unknown historical conversations and absent tool logs are UNKNOWN, not zero.
